summary: Quiet day for the priority four: nothing new from Lasso, URLgenius, Button or Amazon's link tools in news, wires, blogs, X, LinkedIn or Reddit in the last ~30 hours. No new WordPress.org releases for Lasso Lite (v160) or Pretty Links (v4.0.16).
Bitly posted on X and LinkedIn about telling apart short links, smart links, deep links and dynamic QR codes, a sign that shorteners are moving into 'smart link' language.
Lnk.bio added an accessibility widget (Sienna) to its link-in-bio pages, and Skimlinks is telling publishers to get Q4 gift content live in October.
On Reddit, a creator said an AI chatbot pointed them to a lesser-known link-in-bio tool (Unil.ink) instead of Beacons.
